item.title: Thursday 29 October: Fed Hike Dissent, French Spread
item.description: The Fed held with two votes for a hike and the ten-year Treasury is above five percent; European banks posted record third-quarter profits but SEB's capital add-on and French debt stress linger; Jio Platforms debuted 27 percent higher in Mumbai.

item.title: Wednesday 28 October: HSBC Miss, French Debt
item.description: HSBC's third-quarter profit jumps 32% to 9.6 billion dollars but revenue misses and bank shares fall, French ten-year yields sit near 5% ahead of the budget vote, and Deutsche Bank reports ahead of tonight's Fed decision.
